hotspots.title: Flávio Bolsonaro Defeat & Brazil Election Fraud Claims
hotspots.blurb: Flávio Bolsonaro fled Brazil for the United States via Argentina and Ecuador after refusing to accept his presidential election defeat to Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva. Operating from Florida, Bolsonaro released a letter declaring himself the rightful leader of Brazil and claiming an institutional coup took place, drawing swift condemnation, internal party isolation, and legal maneuvers to declare him ineligible.
hotspots.affect: Commands white-hot attention due to high-stakes legal drama, international flight, and explosive claims of stolen elections that challenge democratic legitimacy.

hotspots.title: Marine Le Pen Launches RN Campaign & Congress
hotspots.blurb: Marine Le Pen launched her 2027 presidential campaign at the Rassemblement National congress under the theme of 'Renaissance,' framing her party as the defender of national sovereignty and security. The launch ignited ferocious political warfare as left-wing opponents demanded media censorship of RN politicians, while Le Pen's legal team launched appeals against senior magistrates asserting her legal ineligibility for office.
hotspots.affect: Commands maximum affective investment around the frontrunner for the French presidency battling potential judicial disqualification and intense left-wing hostility.

hotspots.title: PiS Internal Crisis Over Kaczyński's Polexit Remarks
hotspots.blurb: PiS chairman Jarosław Kaczyński sparked a major political crisis in Poland after suggesting a 'hard and risky' EU exit strategy during a forum address to force European Union reforms. The comments drew immediate attacks from Prime Minister Donald Tusk, who warned of national catastrophe, while exposing a bitter internal rift within PiS leadership between Kaczyński and former Prime Minister Mateusz Morawiecki.
hotspots.affect: Generates widespread alarm and outrage due to existential debates over Poland's European integration and open warfare inside the primary opposition party.

hotspots.title: Nigel Farage MP Altercation Row & Reform Campaign
hotspots.blurb: Reform UK leader Nigel Farage triggered intense parliamentary debate after claiming he skipped the Chancellor's Budget to avoid a 'physical altercation,' which was swiftly followed by accusations that he shoved a female Lib Dem MP. The explosive dispute between Reform UK and Liberal Democrats coincides with Reform's launch of a nationwide campaign newspaper, 'The Reformer,' distributed to millions of households.
hotspots.affect: Drives high emotional charge through physical altercation accusations inside Parliament and aggressive populist propaganda pushes against mainstream parties.

hotspots.title: Trump Midterm Rallies & Campaign Trail Violence
hotspots.blurb: Donald Trump's midterm campaign swing generated intense media heat following the abrupt cancellation of his Salina, Kansas rally alongside high-visibility appearances in Ohio and South Carolina. Partisan battles intensified over rally crowd sizes, provocative campaign attack ads, and warnings from commentators over whether election outcomes will be accepted.
hotspots.affect: Sustains high emotional charge around hyper-partisan battleground combat, crowd-size disputes, and underlying anxieties regarding election integrity.
